title: Copies before the Storm
story: A radio warning said a storm might cut the power that night. The family wanted to protect their holiday photos. Dad copied the pictures from the computer onto a spare drive. Mum checked that the files opened before they continued. They copied the school projects as well. Then they shut down the computer and unplugged it from the wall. They also unplugged the router and the printer. The youngest child, Leila, charged a small lamp while the power was still on. She put the lamp and the spare drive on a high shelf. When the lights went out, the house was dark but the files were safe. They played a quiet card game by the lamp. In the morning the power returned. Dad plugged the computer in and opened the beach album. Every photo was there, including the one of Leila with the red kite.
